author: AsianEyes
body:
I am sorry for my previous actions as a player, and I have decided to move on in a positive manner. I will try to refrain myself from talking in chat in a violent way and keep myself from getting too aggressive. I hope you can consider my appeal fairly and without bias.


-With Kind Regards, Amry

replies.body:
Sorry for the long wait, but racism isn't allowed on Avicus. I see that you made a mistake, so appeal again in 3-5 months and your chances of being unbanned will be greater.

Regards,
Junr

This appeal will be left open for the next 24 hours.
